essence: Reverence to the lord involves offering fragrances, flowers and incense while bowing with the head.
Making the offering at the lower head brings about success.
Bathing in the Kaveri destroys sin.
Bathing in that very river on the fourteenth day results in the destruction of sin.
Proper bathing in the Kaushiki liberates one from all sins.
